sources.shortCitation: Odeon O-11811, “Mein Gorilla hat ’ne Villa im Zoo” (recorded Berlin, 13 February 1933)
sources.fullCitation: Hans Albers with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Otto Dobrindt. “Mein Gorilla hat ’ne Villa im Zoo.” Paso doble. Odeon O-11811, matrix Be 10227-2, 1933. Digital transfer on YouTube; session data consulted in the Odeon label list at musiktiteldb.de.
sources.title: Mein Gorilla hat ’ne Villa im Zoo — Odeon O-11811
sources.creator: Hans Albers, with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Otto Dobrindt
sources.researchNote: The uploader’s description supplies the matrix number; the label is not shown. The recording date, take, studio and April 1933 release follow the Odeon label list at musiktiteldb.de. The companion side, matrix Be 10226, survives in a filmed-label transfer and is documented as part of the same session.

sources.fullCitation: jonjamg, uploader. “Hans Albers - In 24 Stunden.” YouTube audio reference, uploaded 30 January 2011. Accessed 15 August 2026.
sources.title: Hans Albers - In 24 Stunden — YouTube
sources.creator: jonjamg (YouTube channel)
sources.researchNote: The upload description names Hans Albers with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Otto Dobrindt but gives no catalogue or matrix number. Its authorship allocation—music to Jurmann and words to Kaper and Rotter—conflicts with the printed sources and is not used as authority for the work credits.

sources.shortCitation: Odeon O-11811 a, “Immer wenn ich glücklich bin” (recorded Berlin, 13 February 1933)
sources.fullCitation: Hans Albers with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Otto Dobrindt. “Immer wenn ich glücklich bin.” Foxtrot from the Boston sound film Heut’ kommt’s drauf an; label credits music to Walter Jurmann and B. Kaper and words to Fritz Rotter. Odeon O-11811 a, matrix Be 10226, 78 rpm, 1933. Filmed-label transfer published on YouTube by Schellackplatte on 21 May 2008.
sources.title: Immer wenn ich glücklich bin — Odeon O-11811 a
sources.creator: Hans Albers; Odeon-Künstler-Orchester, Otto Dobrindt, conductor
sources.researchNote: The recording date of 13 February 1933, Berlin studio 2, and the April 1933 release follow the Odeon label list at musiktiteldb.de. The filmed copy carries a C. A. Klemm dealer sticker and a notice prohibiting radio transmission without permission.

sources.fullCitation: Hans Albers with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester conducted by O. Dobrindt. “Ich bin der Hans im Glück” / “In 24 Stunden.” Odeon O-11810, shellac, 10-inch, 78 rpm, Germany, 1933. Discogs release 28872088.
sources.title: Ich bin der Hans im Glück / In 24 Stunden — Odeon O-11 810
sources.creator: Hans Albers; Odeon-Künstler-Orchester, O. Dobrindt, conductor
sources.researchNote: Discogs identifies “In 24 Stunden” as matrix Be 10225-2 and the reverse as Be 10224. The recording date, take, Berlin studio and April 1933 release are independently supplied by the Odeon label list at musiktiteldb.de.

sources.fullCitation: König, Henry, comp. “Labelliste von „Odeon“ (1928–1933), Labelcode 00287: Odeon 78 rpm, Labelnummern von O-11000 bis O-11999.” musiktiteldb.de. 503 sides recorded, with matrix numbers, recording dates and studios, release months and parallel issues, compiled from the Discographie der deutschen Kleinkunst and related discographies; owner and manufacturer of the series given as Carl Lindström GmbH. Accessed 21 August 2026.

media.title: Hans Albers in Berlin, 1924
media.altText: Black-and-white photograph of the actor Hans Albers in a coat and hat on a Berlin street, 1924.
media.publicCaption: Hans Albers photographed walking Unter den Linden in Berlin, 1924 — nine years before he took the lead in Heut’ kommt’s drauf an, the 1933 comedy for which Kaper and Jurmann wrote the songs.
media.publicCreditLine: Bundesarchiv, Bild 102-00586A / photographer unknown; CC BY-SA 3.0 DE.

contributions.scopeNote: filmportal.de lists Hans Albers in the lead role of dance-band leader Hans Eckmann. No linked source attributes a specific song performance to him; this credit therefore records his acting role, not the performance of an individual number.
Recorded the song for Odeon with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Otto Dobrindt; he also played the lead in Heut’ kommt’s drauf an, the film the song comes from.
Sang the song on Odeon O-11811 a with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under Otto Dobrindt; he also played the lead in Heut’ kommt’s drauf an, the film named on the label.

Sang the song on Odeon O-11 810 side B, matrix Be 10225, with the Odeon-Künstler-Orchester under O. Dobrindt; he also played the lead in Heut’ kommt’s drauf an, the film named on the release. The disc is documented by a user-contributed Discogs entry, corroborated by the companion Odeon O-11811 label, which names the same orchestra, conductor and film.
